sections.title: DNP Project Evaluation and Dissemination (DNP Project #4)
sections.description: The Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) project is the terminal project for fulfillment of the DNP Degree requirements. The DNP Project prepares students to lead and conduct a scientific clinical inquiry project that integrates and applies learning from coursework and clinical practicums. The DNP project is a logical extension of the practice emersion experience, and uses evidence and the literature-related information to guide improvements in either practice or patient outcomes. The DNP Project will culminate in the development of an evidence-based, practice manuscript.
